en: A black‑and‑white photograph of an ornate historic theatre building seen from a landscaped park with trimmed hedges, flower beds and a large tropical-looking plant in the foreground. The building has a grand arched central façade with tall windows, rich stucco ornamentation and two high corner towers topped with sculptural groups of figures and chariots. Trees and a street with mid‑20th‑century cars or streetlights are visible to the right.
